content.text: Santa Barbara First Timers Travel Guide + Best Things to do! Welcome to beautiful Santa Barbara, California—the American Riviera! In this ultimate travel guide, I’ll show you everything you need to know about visiting Santa Barbara, including where to stay, what to eat, the best beaches, top neighborhoods, and unforgettable day trips like Solvang and wine country. From the iconic State Street and trendy Funk Zone, to historic spots like the Old Mission and hidden gems like Hendry’s Beach, Santa Barbara has something for every traveler.
